What if you slept on the floor every night?
Some people say it helps their back, others just like a cool floor in summer. Sounds uncomfortable, right? You'd have no soft mattress to sink into.

But here's the twist. In Japan, many people sleep on futons on the floor, and some people with back pain say a firm surface helps, though science isn't sure yet! The floor can be cold and dusty though, so a good mat matters. People with joint pain, older adults, or anyone who gets cold easily might do better with a bed.
